This fully furnished 1 BHK builder floor apartment is available for sale in Tambaram West, Chennai. Situated on the first floor of a single-floor building, the property spans 600 square meters and is less than a year old, ensuring modern construction and design. The apartment features one bathroom and includes additional rooms such as a pooja room, study room, in-house garden, servant room, and kids room, making it ideal for a family. The flooring is ceramic, and the unit comes equipped with essential furnishings like lights, fans, and geysers. Parking is convenient with one car parking space and one two-wheeler parking spot. The property is located in a gated community, offering security and peace of mind, and it is a corner plot facing southwest, allowing good ventilation and sunlight. Amenities include corporation water supply and 24/7 power backup, ensuring uninterrupted living comfort. The apartment is pet-friendly and suitable for families with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food habits. The property will be available for possession within 1-2 weeks. Interested buyers can contact the broker between 3 PM and 6 PM for more details. This is a great opportunity to own a well-maintained, ready-to-move-in home in a prime location of Chennai.
